about_the_game:
The new part of the cult series from Reanim Games — MEMASIKI: IS MY 2007TH. This is not just a sequel, it is a journey to the era of the birth of Internet memes, when digital humor was just beginning to conquer the hearts of users around the world.

MEMASIKI: IS MY 2007TH offers you a unique opportunity to test your knowledge of those very first memes that laid the foundation for modern meme culture. In each round, you will find an image and description taken straight from the era of early forums and social networks. Your task is to correctly identify what kind of meme is in front of you by choosing one of the proposed options.

For each correct answer, you get +1 point, but be careful: the wrong choice will take away one point from you. The special feature of the game is that all the memes are as close as possible to their historical originals, preserving their unique style and atmosphere of that era. In addition, the game has a system of achievements that only a true connoisseur of memes can collect!

Upon completion of the game, the system will assign you one of six statuses that will accurately describe your level of immersion in the culture of the birth of Internet humor. From "Noob" to "Legend" - everyone will find their level!

MEMASIKI: IS MY 2007TH is more than a game. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the nostalgic atmosphere of the beginning of Internet culture, laugh at jokes that have become classics, and demonstrate your skills to your friends. If you love memes and appreciate their history, then this project was created especially for you. Become part of the legendary era and prove that you are a true expert in meme culture!
